narrative.introduction: The Fungi Ontology catalogs canonical culinary fungi — edible fungi used as culinary ingredients worldwide. This domain models ingredients, not biological taxonomy.
narrative.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary fungi by group — usage intensity, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
narrative.summary: Canonical culinary fungi across four immutable groups: Cultivated Mushrooms, Wild Mushrooms, Truffles, and Specialty Fungi.
